subject: Temporary coverage lift request: P1/P2 response during peak deploy
messages:
From: Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@tessco.com>
To: support@redwood.com; logan.wright@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary coverage lift request: P1/P2 response during peak deploy

Hi Logan / Redwood support team,

We're ramping a customer-facing migration next week (Tue 6/23 through Thu 6/25) that will introduce higher traffic and a narrow risk window. Our SRE lead asked me to request a temporary tightening of P1 and P2 response SLAs for those three days — specifically:

- P1: 15-minute acknowledgement, 60-minute full response (current contract: 30/4h)
- P2: 1-hour acknowledgement, 4-hour full response (current contract: 4h/24h)

We understand this is an exception to our baseline SLA. Tessco is prepared to sign an MOU for the temporary change and cover incremental support fees. Can you confirm feasibility and whom to loop in for approvals? Also need an escalation ladder in case of cross-region failover.

Thanks,
Morgan Lee
Director of Platform Ops, Tessco
ops@tessco.com

--
Attachment: deployment-runbook-v2.pdf (reference only)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@tessco.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary coverage lift request: P1/P2 response during peak deploy

Thanks Morgan — looping the on-call & ops leads. Quick thoughts:

- Operationally feasible if we:
  1) Bring forward an additional primary responder for P1 during 06/23–06/25 peak window (08:00–20:00 PT),
  2) Shorten batching thresholds for affected routes to reduce tail latency, and
  3) Gate the change behind a signed MOU and a confirmed follow-the-sun escalation contact.

Irene / Karthik — can you confirm headcount availability for 06/23–06/25 and whether we can commit to 15/60 for P1 and 1/4 for P2 for the specified window? If not, propose the minimum mitigations (e.g., pairing with Dedicated pool for critical routes).

Monica — finance will need quick pricing for the 3-day uplift (estimated support uplift + potential credits).

Morgan — please attach the proposed MOU; we'll route to legal for expedited review.

- Logan
Logan Wright
Senior Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference

--
(Attachment: none in this reply)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@tessco.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary coverage lift request: P1/P2 response during peak deploy

Logan / team — I checked rota and we can staff the tighter P1 coverage by borrowing one senior on-call shift each day (09:00–18:00 PT) from the Dedicated support pool and add an on-call secondary for 18:00–02:00 PT to handle any late incidents. That gets us to the 15-min ack target for the daytime window.

Constraints / notes:
- This is a manual carve-in; responders will be pulled from other commitments and should be paid overtime or credited.
- We need clear scope for what constitutes P1 vs degradation (rate-limit/backpressure events should be pre-approved as P2 unless customer impact confirmed).
- Escalation ladder proposed: responder -> Irene (on-call lead) -> Logan (SRM) -> Monica (Customer Ops lead) -> Redwood CTO on call (if cross-region failure).

I'll attach a proposed on-call schedule and the quick MOU draft for legal.

Irene Choi
Staff SRE, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: oncall_schedule_proposed.csv

Subject: Re: Temporary coverage lift request: P1/P2 response during peak deploy

Team / Morgan — finance has a preliminary uplift figure: $9,500 for the 3-day window (covers overtime + priority paging + legal processing fees). We can offer a reduced rate if Tessco accepts a follow-on credit against Q3 consumption (50% of uplift credited back).

Morgan, attach a single-point MOU or PO and we will expedite legal/finance. Legal needs a signature page; procurement email is CC'd.

Next steps I propose:
1) Tessco confirms MOU or PO by EOD Mon 6/22
2) Redwood legal signs and returns an approved MOU by Tue 6/23 morning
3) On-call schedule is locked and communicated by Tue 6/23 08:00 PT

Monica Patel
Director, Customer Operations
Redwood Inference
